name: boo-arcade
description: BOO Arcade — native iOS/Android wrapper for the Bunch of Others HTML5 arcade. Source-of-truth games live in ../Games/; build-www.sh syncs them into www/ before each build.

scripts.ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
